study.question: Can task-specific feedback/value covariance complement, rather than replace, the incumbent target-match representation at justified added parameter and measured runtime cost? Does its event alignment or task specificity matter beyond a matched-capacity duplicate-match branch?
study.hypothesis: Observed r0078 replacement AUCs were typed aligned 0.665785166, typed rotated 0.666794984, union aligned 0.666055617 and union rotated 0.667365214, all below g0-r0069-buy_summary_direction at 0.668531811. Aligned membership lost to rotated membership in both scopes. Thus existing results do not support the replacement mechanism. Code inspection shows that those trials removed a useful fifth target-match direction from BOTH the residual adapter and history projection. Loss of that direction is a plausible alternative explanation, not an established mechanism. Retaining every original path and adding a separately compressed, zero-output-initialized context/feedback interaction may permit complementary signal extraction. A useful implementation must exceed the historical parent and the new duplicate-match capacity control; aligned-versus-rotated and typed-versus-union contrasts identify narrower information claims. One fixed-seed result is preliminary.

study.proposed_difference: Append four bias-free value_width-to-rank16 projections and four rank16-to-value_width zero-initialized outputs AFTER all inherited initialization inside its RNG fork. Reuse each task context query. For each source center coefficients within each valid 10-event block, scale whole-history coefficient L2 norm to the inherited within-block position coefficient norm, contract with explicitly masked item/action values and divide by sqrt(valid event count). Compute aligned and rotated task/union banks and a normalized duplicate of existing target affinity in EVERY cell. A per-task common gate requires nonzero centered task, union and target-match coefficient norms. Select task aligned, task rotated, union aligned or match duplicate as the ONLY between-cell change. The new correction is Wout[RMS(tanh(Wcontext context)*tanh(Wextension summary))] and is added to the complete inherited correction. New branch uses native gradients; detach its entire summary for auxiliary losses while preserving the existing allowed adapter context path. No loss, optimizer, host data or scorer changes. Expected W=112 gives +14336 dense parameters, 413541 dense,31793216 embedding,32206757 total; host must measure and verify. Common support prevents source-availability differences within this suite but narrows the hypothesis.
predictions: feedback_additive will exceed both feedback_rotated and match_capacity if useful aligned feedback/value covariance complements existing match detail; it must also exceed historical parent0.668531811 and frozen source bests0.660646940/0.660163363 to justify a predictive follow-up.

feedback_additive exceeding feedback_union at the same alignment will provide preliminary support for task-specific membership beyond shared union membership on the common support. No task-by-alignment interaction is identified because union-rotated is omitted.

All original branch tensors/operators remain identical at common inherited state; new outputs start at zero, yielding parent-equivalent initial predictions. After learning, additional summary source changes may affect shared context gradients. Unsupported rows have exactly zero direct new correction, although learning on supported rows may indirectly change their later predictions.

Every new cell has identical parameter counts and forward bank arithmetic. Runtime, actual backward work, memory and throughput are measured outcomes; added parameters and shared forward construction imply neither equal compute nor an efficiency gain.
falsifiers: If feedback_additive fails to exceed parent and match_capacity, useful complementarity is unsupported for this branch/support/training implementation. This does not refute all feedback compression or INFNet.
If aligned fails to beat rotated, do not claim beneficial event-aligned feedback covariance even when either beats parent. If typed fails to beat union, do not claim task specificity.
If all new cells improve similarly, generic capacity, the common availability gate or changed optimization remain sufficient explanations. No mechanism claim follows from a parent improvement alone.

Nonfinite predictions/loss/gradients, incorrect task routing, invalid-padding sensitivity, changed frozen information/ownership or failure of original-state parity blocks scientific interpretation and triggers repair before charged training.
An advantage that disappears under permitted paired repetitions, or is explained by unacceptable measured time/memory cost, is not a supported quality-cost improvement.
